commands.summary: System Python 3.12.4 built and installed RepoPact 3.1.3.dev1. The subsequent system-path CLI validation found the pre-existing repopact-engine.exe at 3.1.0.dev1, so final checks were isolated in a checkout-local virtual environment.
System script resolution paired RepoPact 3.1.3.dev1 with the stale system engine 3.1.0.dev1. No repository files were changed by this failed invocation.
Checkout-local Python 3.12.4 environment installed the editable RepoPact package and built its Rust engine. The CLI reports 3.1.3dev1 and the paired engine reports 3.1.3.dev1.
All 51 Windows admission, guard-authority and confinement tests passed in 413.936 seconds.

The Windows semantic/pre-action harness passed all seven cases. The report classified its backend as testing-only with process_confined=false and path_confined=false; the protected production service was unavailable and not run.
The Python compatibility comparator passed 37/37 cases and the WI050 admission corpus passed 8/8 vectors.
Full suite passed: 380 tests, 3 skips, 0 failures, in 1423.567 seconds. Skips were the Windows-inapplicable Unix service test and the documented O-4/O-6 formal-model tests.
Dashboard regenerated after recording the RPS-012 partial validation evidence.
Final canonical validation passed after the work-item evidence link and dashboard were updated.

limitations: RPS-012 remains pending because this run did not install or exercise a production protected service. The passing Windows harness proves semantic/pre-action behavior only.
Prior Linux WSL2 admission and Landlock evidence remains partial and does not prove production protected-service installation or macOS behavior.
The system-wide script directory still contains a stale 3.1.0.dev1 engine; all passing final checks used the checkout-local virtual environment.
